title: Add/standardize activation events for onboarding funnel (signup → API key → first request → 100k tokens)
author: Nadia Rahman
release_notes: Internal-only: Adds standardized activation funnel events and dedupe rules for lifecycle growth experiments; updates tracking docs + dashboards mapping.
description: Context: Lifecycle Growth Experiments sprint needs a consistent, deduped activation funnel across Hosted API + Console. This PR introduces a canonical event taxonomy for the core onboarding milestones and wires emission from both the API gateway + console surfaces so we can measure (a) first successful request and (b) first 100k tokens within 7 days. Events added/standardized: (1) rwi.signup_completed, (2) rwi.api_key_created, (3) rwi.first_successful_request, (4) rwi.tokens_milestone_reached (milestone=100000). Dedupe: we’ve seen retries, refreshes, and async delivery cause duplicates that inflate conversion; this PR adds a deterministic idempotency key per user+event+day (plus request_id where available) and a 24h TTL on the dedupe store. Also aligns required properties and naming conventions with analytics datasets so Growth can build a stable funnel dashboard + experiment readouts. Notes: This does not change billing/metering logic; it is strictly product analytics events used for activation measurement and lifecycle triggers (per policy).
changed_areas: services/api-gateway: emit rwi.first_successful_request after 2xx completion + model routed, include request_id + region
apps/console: emit rwi.api_key_created on successful key create, include auth_method + workspace_id
packages/telemetry: new event schema definitions + required props validation
services/telemetry-ingest: idempotency key + TTL dedupe cache
analytics/event-mapping: updated mapping doc + sample queries for funnel stages
commits: telemetry: add activation funnel event schema + required properties
api-gateway: emit first_successful_request on first 2xx completion

checks: CI: build-and-test (pass), lint (pass), typecheck (pass), unit-tests (pass), api-integration-tests (pass), console-e2e-smoke (pass). First run failed on console-e2e-smoke due to flaky timing on API key modal; rerun passed after increasing waitFor timeout in test harness.
body:
What / Why: We’re running a 4-week Lifecycle Growth Experiments sprint (email onboarding v2 + in-console nudges + retargeting). To measure activation and avoid noisy readouts, we need consistent event definitions across surfaces, with dedupe and required properties enforced. This PR adds/standardizes the core activation funnel events (signup → API key → first successful request → first 100k tokens) and implements an idempotency strategy to prevent inflated conversions due to retries, refreshes, and async delivery.

Scope: Adds canonical event names under the rwi.* namespace; adds schema validation for required properties; emits events from API gateway and console; adds ingest-side dedupe (idempotency key + TTL); updates analytics mapping docs and provides sample queries for funnel validation.

Event definitions: 1) rwi.signup_completed (source=console|auth, user_id, workspace_id, signup_method, region, occurred_at) 2) rwi.api_key_created (user_id, workspace_id, key_type, auth_method, source=console, occurred_at) 3) rwi.first_successful_request (user_id, workspace_id, request_id, model, route, region, sdk, status_code=2xx, occurred_at) 4) rwi.tokens_milestone_reached (user_id, workspace_id, milestone=100000, token_type=input|output|total, window=rolling_7d, occurred_at).

Dedupe approach: We compute an idempotency_key = sha256(user_id + event_name + stable_dimensions + date_bucket) for events without request_id, and sha256(user_id + event_name + request_id) when request_id exists. Ingest stores keys for 24 hours in the dedupe cache and drops repeats; we still forward a counter metric for deduped_drops to monitor changes in upstream duplication.

Implementation notes: - first_successful_request is emitted after successful completion (not on request start) to avoid counting auth failures/timeouts as activation. - api_key_created is emitted only after the API returns 201 and the key is persisted. - tokens_milestone_reached is computed from existing token usage aggregation; this PR only standardizes the event emission point and properties, not the aggregation logic.

Testing: Unit tests cover schema validation and idempotency key generation; integration tests validate first_successful_request is only emitted once per user even with retries; console smoke tests validate api_key_created is not emitted on modal open/dismiss.

Privacy/compliance: Events are limited to product usage telemetry already permitted for lifecycle measurement; no prompt/body content is included. Workspace_id is included for aggregation but no customer PII beyond user_id.

Follow-ups (tracked separately): - Tighten signup_completed emission to avoid double-fire on auth callback refresh (ENG follow-up) - Confirm tokens_milestone_reached windowing matches KPI definition in PM-651 (Mei + Growth) - Add dashboard alert for dedupe_drops spike (Observability).
review_conversation:
Logan Wright (review): Schema looks good, but please make required props explicit and fail closed. We can’t have half-populated events in prod if Growth is building funnels off these. Also, can we instrument a metric for dropped duplicates so we can detect upstream regressions?

Nadia Rahman (author): Updated the schema validator to fail closed for these four events (others remain warn-only for now). Added telemetry_ingest.dedupe_dropped_total with event_name + source dimensions.

Mei Lin (review): For first_successful_request: do we want to bucket by model_route vs requested_model? Requested_model may be null for SDK defaults; route is stable but can change with fallback. Suggest: include both requested_model (nullable) + routed_model (required) + fallback_reason (nullable).

Nadia Rahman (author): Implemented requested_model (nullable) + routed_model (required) and added fallback_reason when routing policy triggers a change.

Dylan Brooks (review): Console side: api_key_created should fire after persistence, not on optimistic UI. Also ensure dismissal of the modal doesn’t emit. Looks like you’ve got it, but add an e2e assertion.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added a console e2e smoke assertion around key creation success path; confirmed no emission on cancel/dismiss.

Paula Mendes (review): Dedupe: 24h TTL is fine, but we need deterministic key semantics documented because downstream pipelines will ask. Please add a short note in the tracking spec and link to it from the PR.

Nadia Rahman (author): Added a “Dedupe / idempotency” section to the internal tracking spec and linked it in the PR body.

Allison Grant (review): Add a small guardrail: if dedupe_dropped_total suddenly spikes after release, we should have an alert or at least a dashboard panel. Not blocking but please create a follow-up ticket.

Nadia Rahman (author): Created follow-up for dashboard panel/alert tuning (assigned to Sergio) and referenced it in follow-ups section.

Final status: Approved by Logan Wright, Mei Lin, Dylan Brooks, Paula Mendes. Merged via squash after CI passed.
